description: RYOBI introduces the Hobby Station. Designed to enhance control with maximum precision. The on-board accessory compartments help you stay organized by keeping your accessories within reach. The drill press functionality features a 2 in. depth for precision drilling making all of your hobby and craft projects easier than ever.
